9c0c33b1e08fa3f1: Fast-forward can help with repeated opening animations and slowly appearing text, while slow speed can help you observe actions. Yearn provides speed controls in the game menu as well as an on-screen fast-forward control. This guide first establishes a baseline at normal speed, then changes the pace a little at a time to distinguish the effects of speed settings from those of device performance.
9e10c56e3f6170de: For repeated dialogue, fast-forward reduces waiting; when it is time to choose an option, return to normal speed in advance so that a single button press does not skip through multiple choices. In walking or action scenes, fast-forward reduces your reaction time, and a distance that was easy to control may suddenly take you past the target, so test it in an open area first.
9ef7c582230d5688: You can record your observations in two rounds: first, whether normal speed is stable, and second, whether a particular faster setting is useful. If normal speed itself is unstable, address the basic running problems first. Increasing the multiplier will not automatically make a slow device faster, nor can you use it to infer compatibility and performance for every console.
a398203d0844c15b: Start with a lower fast-forward multiplier
b1f6df0131e7e82e: After selecting slow speed in the speed menu, choose an easily recognizable action, such as a character jumping, an object moving, or a menu animation. Compare it with the same action at normal speed to confirm that what you are seeing is the action taking longer, rather than the screen freezing or input becoming unresponsive.
b2ba01935fdeb02c: What if the character keeps moving after I return to normal speed?
ba0499878432ace5: Use fast-forward separately for dialogue and action
d234e98d3fc300e7: Do not treat enabling fast-forward and repeatedly pressing Confirm at the same time as the default way to play. You could skip important text, trigger menu options, or write an in-game save without realizing it. For your first comparison, speed up the parts that run automatically while continuing to control your inputs deliberately.
fb48726197096b45: When you finish the exercise, confirm that normal speed has been restored, then save a separate checkpoint that you are satisfied with. The ideal result is to understand which kinds of waiting suit fast-forward, which actions benefit from observation at slow speed, and how to return reliably to normal play, rather than finding the highest multiplier.
fc675feabac7349b: Open a game that already runs reliably, stop in a safe place, and first confirm that it is running at normal speed. Save a checkpoint manually and note the scene and save slot so that you can return to a known position while experimenting with speed changes. For your first attempt, avoid critical scenes where you only get one chance, and do not overwrite your only save with an experimental state.
fd9e81dfdf16434b: Try holding the on-screen fast-forward button briefly, then release it and check whether the speed indicator and actual pace return to normal. Check the speed level selected in the menu separately as well; before any action requiring precise input, explicitly return to normal speed, then continue.
